name: The Thesis
summary: An argued spine: the book advances and proves one claim about the agentic era, rather than following a protagonist's journey.
rules: The unit that must cohere is the ARGUMENT: claim, evidence, counterexample, restatement. Nine of this universe's shipped books use it (come-look, nobody-labeled-the-door, it-only-has-to-fly, the-best-news-ever, the-smoke-test, the-dress-rehearsal, the-encore, the-room-it-was-made-in, finders-tell-their-friends). A thesis book needs no character arc, no waiting season, no vindication; judge it against the integrity of its argument. The claim is stated early in concrete story terms, every movement is a piece of evidence a child could retell, and the refrain is the claim compressed to something a reader can carry.
origin: Backfilled 2026-08-08 from the nine shipped thesis books; the dominant spine of this universe.
